CR 5

hp 66 (12d10)

Melee swarm (3d6 plus distraction) Space 10 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks distraction, versatile strike

STATISTICS

Base Atk +12; CMB +12; CMD 21

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Versatile Strike (Ex)

As a weapon swarm is comprised of a variety of weapons, the damage it inflicts is considered bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, and a steel swarm strikes as cold iron and silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
